_about: Period corrections to upstream's monsters, items and quests (levels, spots, prices, rewards), applied at every start by deploy/bin/mob_fixes.py (run by world_fixes.py). Each entry names a Mob row by Mob_ID, the NpcTemplate rows of a TemplateId, an ItemTemplate row by Id_nb or a DataQuest row by ID; the row changes only while it holds every expect value (upstream's), so the owner's own changes stay. The entries of one decision that depend on each other (a quest's rewards) share a group, which changes whole or not at all. Every entry says why, with its source.

fixes.why: Midgard's "Sveabone Hilt Sword" (Gridash, Vasudheim): "Buy a bronze short sword from Gyda, southwest of the Jordheim bridge, and give it to Gridash." DataQuest takes an item whose Id_nb contains the step's turn-in id, and upstream's id was cq_bronze_short_sword, which nothing sells, drops or hands out, so the quest could not be finished (#100, found 2026-10-10 by a scan of every turn-in of the 1,302 classic quests; the only one with no source).
